summary: Elicio Therapeutics filed an 8-K (Item 8.01, Other Events) on June 17, 2026, attaching a press release that reports preliminary clinical observations from its Phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P study. The release highlights three metastatic pancreatic cancer patients who achieved complete radiographic and metabolic responses after receiving ELI-002 7P followed by nivolumab-based therapy. This is a clinical development update with no deal terms, transaction, or special-situation corporate event. The filing discloses no financial terms, board recommendation, or imminent structural change. The company plans a Phase 1 study in first-line metastatic KRAS-mutant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, subject to funding. The press release serves as the sole exhibit. No special-situation categorization applies; the filing is a routine clinical update.
